deep_link_scheme.description: 01 R5 — the custom URL scheme THIS app registers. Default `appmap`; an app installed beside another instrumented app must pick its own, because the OS routes a scheme both apps claim to whichever it likes (issue #25). The map stays scheme-relative: every deep_link/url in the YAML is written `appmap://` and rewritten to this scheme when a URL is handed to a driver.

version.description: app version as a string (02 §3) — quote it in YAML: an unquoted 1.0 parses as a number

build_number.description: build number as a string (02 §8) — quote it in YAML: an unquoted 4412 parses as a number

git_sha.description: commit sha as a string (02 §3) — quote it in YAML: an unquoted 0000000 parses as the number 0
